statusLine.command: input=$(cat); raw_dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd'); t="$raw_dir"; while [ "${t%/}" != "$t" ]; do t="${t%/}"; done; if [ "$t" = "$HOME" ]; then dir="~"; elif [ -z "$t" ]; then dir="/"; else dir="${t##*/}"; fi; branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$raw_dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.id'); effort=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); ctx=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); out="$dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out ($branch)"; out="$out | $model"; [ -n "$effort" ] && out="$out@$effort"; [ -n "$ctx" ] && out="$out $(printf '%02.0f' "$ctx")%"; printf '%s' "$out"
